read_file_range.name: read_file_range
read_file_range.purpose: Adaptive pure read: range, function, class, section, or file summary.
read_file_range.description: Adaptive pure read: range, function, class, section, or file summary. Small files auto-expand; large files remain bounded and return AST-aware next_ranges. On a LARGE or unfamiliar repo do NOT bulk-read to understand it - ask the index first (cbm_graph_status for freshness, cbm_get_architecture for the module graph + entrypoints, cbm_dsm for coupling, cbm_trace_path between two files, find_symbol or search_code mode=symbol for the exact line), then read ONE bounded range. That is the CSLt order: structure from the graph, then the smallest read that answers the question. This is also the ONLY call that seeds the write_fix read_token, so read the exact region before editing it and use force_reseed=true after FILE_CHANGED_OUTSIDE_ORCHESTRATOR; its content_hash is a raw-bytes digest and must NEVER be passed as write_fix.expected_hash.

search_code.name: search_code
search_code.description: Unified code/search entrypoint. mode defaults to text; supported modes: text|regex|symbol|callers|definition_usage|index|smart. DOM element candidates are not served by search_code — use the query_dom_candidates tool with a live page_id. Legacy tool names route here as HTTP aliases (find_callers / find_definition_and_usage / regex_search / read_chunks are DEPRECATED - come here instead). query_encoding = plain|base64. Pick by SEMANTICS, not habit: search_code answers WHERE a string or symbol sits, while the cbm_* family answers HOW the repo is shaped - cbm_get_architecture for the module graph and entrypoints, cbm_dsm for coupling, cbm_evolution for churn, cbm_trace_path between two files, cbm_dead_code for unreachable callables. It indexes CODE only, so file_pattern="*.txt"/"*.md"/"*.log" answering 0 hits is a measurement trap, not proof the text is absent - drop the pattern or read the file. It resolves by absolute project_path and never by cwd, so use it whenever a native grep says 'no such file' on a path that certainly exists. mode=callers DOES see instance receivers (self.fn() / obj.fn()), which is exactly why it is the cross-check to run before believing a cbm_dead_code 'no callers' verdict: the cbm graph resolves a call edge only through an imported module/alias, so an empty cbm callers list means 'no RESOLVED reference', never 'unused'.

write_fix.name: write_fix
write_fix.purpose: Edit a code range in a file by replacing it by line numbers.
write_fix.description: Edit a code range in a file by replacing it by line numbers. NO size limit on new_content - send the whole block in one call, and set content_encoding='base64' (UTF-8) whenever new_content is multiline or contains backslashes (Windows paths, regex escapes), double quotes, or non-ASCII/Vietnamese, or when the caller is Windows PowerShell; plain JSON transport can corrupt those. The file's existing line ending (CRLF vs LF) is auto-preserved, so editing a .bat/.ps1 keeps CRLF - no manual newline handling needed. On validation failure the backend opens a draft: response carries draft_id + failed_parts (line-accurate, with excerpts); fix ONLY the failed range via write_draft_patch until clean - the backend then ships automatically. Automatically creates a .bak backup and syncs the cache after the write. Requires INDEX.json to exist first (run generate_project_map). If the file changed outside Orchestrator, returns a conflict. When Python validation fails with a Ruff safe-fixable diagnostic, the response includes ruff_fix_applicable and ruff_fix_hint suggesting ruff_fix(path=<file>, apply=false) for CA-controlled preview; it never auto-fixes. ONE region per call and the shape is FLAT (file_path,start_line,end_line,new_content) - there is no edits[] array, so several regions in the SAME file need several calls and they MUST go BOTTOM-UP: an earlier top region renumbers every line beneath it. expected_hash is a PREVIOUS write_fix.new_hash, never a read_file_range.content_hash (that one is a raw-bytes digest and seeds no edit authority). On a large repo, run cbm_what_if / cbm_dsm on the target first so the edit set is chosen from the call graph instead of guessed, and a client timeout is NOT a failed write - poll /api/write_status?operation_id=... until commit_state is terminal instead of resending.

run_project_command.name: run_project_command
run_project_command.purpose: Run bounded command in project cwd.
run_project_command.description: Run bounded command in project cwd. V15 R14: shell wrapper plus optional background/keep_alive launch verification via expected_port / expected_process_name. JSON transport is a separate layer: encode backslashes before placing command in an outer JSON string. On Windows, shell operators and findstr/dir file reads are fragile; prefer direct search/read tools or script-file transport. Auto routes only a standalone script.ps1 to PowerShell -File; a command such as findstr text script.ps1 remains a normal command. CAN-053 readiness DSL: health_url + expect_status (+ readiness_protocol=http|tcp|cdp|process) verify service readiness over HTTP; CDP_UNREACHABLE is returned ONLY for cdp, dead TCP ports return PORT_UNREACHABLE, failed health probes return HEALTH_PROBE_FAILED; launcher-exited-but-health-ok returns ok_with_warning=true. CASE-2008 destructive guard: a command containing a delete/move/truncate/overwrite statement in ANY runtime (cmd rd/del, PowerShell Remove-Item, node fs.rmSync, python shutil.rmtree, sh rm -rf, git clean) refuses to run until confirm_destructive equals the scanned count, takes a project backup first, and returns untruncated output; dry_run=true previews without executing. A PowerShell -Include paired with -LiteralPath is REFUSED outright (DESTRUCTIVE_SCRIPT_FOOTGUN) because PowerShell silently discards the filter and removes the whole target.

run_project_test_script.description: V15 R43 P1 #5 T2: script-file transport for node|python|powershell|sh. Python selects the first interpreter satisfying required_python_modules; otherwise returns INTERPRETER_CAPABILITY_MISSING without installing packages. Execution failures use SCRIPT_EXEC_FAILED; unsafe inline callers should route here instead of retrying COMMAND_TRANSPORT_UNSAFE or SCRIPT_RUNTIME_REQUIRED. A PowerShell -Include paired with -LiteralPath is REFUSED outright (DESTRUCTIVE_SCRIPT_FOOTGUN) because PowerShell silently discards the filter and removes the whole target.

Runs the council tracker collector and returns the path to the council_live.txt snapshot (broker dispatches + full prompts, raw worker ARGV/output, council_events, latest replies). Call this FIRST when investigating council/broker/worker-dispatch/prompt/reply issues instead of hand-scraping .council. Auto-open is disabled (open_file is a no-op); archive behavior is kept (old snapshot zipped to archives/, fresh one written). save_output=false skips collection and just reads the current snapshot.

xem log hội đồng trực tiếp

kiểm tra dispatch nào chưa có reply
samples: Collect the council live snapshot so I can see the latest worker replies and dispatch states.
Mở snapshot council_live.txt mới nhất để kiểm tra worker nào chưa trả lời dispatch.

cbm_council_context.name: cbm_council_context
cbm_council_context.purpose: T1 read-only: bounded advisory graph context pack for council dispatch (Step 21).
cbm_council_context.description: T1 read-only: bounded advisory graph context pack for council dispatch (Step 21). Leader embeds the block in worker prompts explicitly — never auto-injected, fail-open, never blocks dispatch. name= -> symbol + inbound blast radius; file_path= (name empty) -> all symbols in file + direct callers; omit both -> changed-files pack (detect_changes + direct callers). Bounds COUNCIL_CONTEXT_MAX_FILES=10 / COUNCIL_CONTEXT_MAX_SYMBOLS=50; truncated + truncation_reason list every cap hit.

samples: Build the council graph context pack for the symbol register_tool, including its inbound blast radius, to embed in the worker prompt.
Lập gói ngữ cảnh graph cho file orchestrator_server.py để leader gắn vào brief gửi worker.

restart_orchestrator_via_bat.name: restart_orchestrator_via_bat
restart_orchestrator_via_bat.purpose: Restart [A] via the canonical [A:S] script (start_orchestrator.bat): spawns a hidden helper (CREATE_NO_WINDOW; no console focus-steal) that…
restart_orchestrator_via_bat.description: Restart [A] via the canonical [A:S] script (start_orchestrator.bat): spawns a hidden helper (CREATE_NO_WINDOW; no console focus-steal) that waits delay_seconds then runs [A:S], which kills the old pythonw and relaunches [A] High-IL. Returns immediately with status=restart_queued; poll /health until ok, then verify generation/PID changed. USAGE: for a normal restart call with NO arguments (or just delay_seconds) — the tool auto-targets the current generation; you do NOT pass expected_generation/controller_url/request_id (those are internal). STALE leftovers and HUNG in-process work (executor oldest_active_age or semaphore held_for_sec>=15s) do NOT block [A:S] — the bat kills the process. force_drain+force_drain_reason overrides remaining LIVE (fresh) work and still queues [A:S]. This is the only CA restart path for [A]; restart_orchestrator_via_task is kept for Anh-requested admin/UIPI recovery only. CSLt 2026-07-16: tier T4->T2 (process-lifecycle mutation with built-in safety guards: process discovery, port-owner filter, wait loop).

khởi động lại orchestrator bằng bat
restart via the canonical bat script
restart [A] rồi poll health
samples: Restart ToolA through the canonical bat script with the default delay; I will poll /health for a new generation and PID.
Khởi động lại orchestrator bằng start_orchestrator.bat, không truyền tham số nội bộ nào.

open_session.name: open_session
open_session.purpose: Open or resume the active session for a project and optional agent identity.
open_session.description: Open or resume the active session for a project and optional agent identity. Resume preserves title and mode by default; call rename_session to apply a different title. Opt-in force_new_session closes then creates atomically and refuses pending writes, drafts or audits; apply_requested_title renames in place without changing mode. Flags are mutually exclusive and require agent_id. Distinct non-empty agent_id values may hold concurrent active sessions on one project. R22 verbosity ∈ {full|terse|ref}; drift auto-forces full.

samples: Open or resume the active session for this project under my agent identity before the write batch starts.
